text: Testing plays an essential role in software development. Unit tests check small pieces of code, like individual functions, to make sure they work correctly on their own. Integration tests, on the other hand, verify that different parts of a system work together smoothly, which is equally important. A popular approach called test-driven development encourages writing tests before the actual code, helping developers think carefully about what they need to build. Together, these practices give teams confidence. When tests pass regularly, developers can make changes or add features without fear of breaking something, leading to higher quality software and less stress for everyone involved.
